name: memory_checkpoint
description:
Saves a named snapshot of current session context for cross-client or cross-session continuity.
Use when: pausing work and handing off to another client, ending a session with intent to resume, or bookmarking a significant milestone.
Scope: local filesystem (~/.config/agentic-store/memory/checkpoints/). No network access.
Not for: storing individual facts (use memory_write), logging events (use memory_log).

name.description: Checkpoint name. Auto-generated timestamp if omitted. Letters, digits, hyphens, underscores only. 'latest' is reserved.

task.description: One-sentence description of what you were working on. Required.

decisions.description: Key decisions made during this session.

active_files.description: File paths relevant to the current task.
